title: Design, synthesis and anticancer evaluation of novel 1,3-imidazole-type phenylhistin derivatives: Dual mechanism via P53 induction and microtubulin inhibition.
authors: Chen, Na; Wang, Bo; Wang, Shihao; Wang, Gang; Shen, Zhenlu; Wen, Yongxiu; Li, Jiajia; Zhang, Bo; FengLi; Li, Wenbao; Yang, Wenqiang; Xin, Jie; Ding, Zhongpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯基组氨酸衍生物的抗癌活性及微管蛋白抑制机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: To enhance biological activity and deepen the understanding of the structure-activity relationship, a systematic study was conducted on the 5-position of the 1,3-imidazol-4-yl group in phenylahistin. The interaction between phenylahistin derivative 16j and the colchicine-binding site was first analyzed in detail, leading to the development of a fragment library to replace the tert-butyl group. A series of 20 novel phenylhistin derivatives were designed, synthesized, and characterized. In vitro activity screening using the NCI-H460 human non-small cell lung cancer line showed strong inhibitory activity for most compounds. Among these, compounds 8 f and 8 g exhibited superior activities, with IC(50) values of 10 nM and 2 nM, respectively. Notably, 8 f displayed activity comparable to that of plinabulin, while 8 g was five times more potent. Both compounds 8 f and 8 g were further evaluated across various tumor cell lines showing nanomolar-level potency. Furthermore, detailed biological assays revealed that 8 g and 8 f disrupted microtubule integrity and significantly affected the P53 signaling pathway, strongly inducing G2/M phase arrest, and simultaneously promoting apoptosis in NCI-H460 cells. Molecular docking studies confirmed higher binding scores and stronger affinities for these derivatives at the colchicine-binding site of alpha, beta-tubulin. These findings suggest that the apoptosis-inducing and cytotoxic activities of these derivatives may offer potential clinical value for tumor therapy.
abstract_zh: 为了增强生物活性并深化对构效关系的理解，对苯基组蛋白中1,3-咪唑-4-基的5位进行了系统研究。首先详细分析了苯基组蛋白衍生物16j与秋水仙碱结合位点之间的相互作用，从而开发了一个片段库以替代叔丁基。设计、合成并表征了一系列共20种新型苯基组蛋白衍生物。使用NCI-H460人非小细胞肺癌细胞系进行的体外活性筛选显示，大多数化合物具有强抑制活性。其中，化合物8f和8g表现出优越的活性，其IC(50)值分别为10 nM和2 nM。值得注意的是，8f的活性与plinabulin相当，而8g的效力是其五倍。化合物8f和8g进一步在多种肿瘤细胞系中进行了评估，显示出纳摩尔级别的效力。此外，详细的生物学测定揭示，8g和8f破坏了微管完整性，并显著影响P53信号通路，强烈诱导G2/M期阻滞，同时促进NCI-H460细胞凋亡。分子对接研究证实，这些衍生物在α,β-微管蛋白的秋水仙碱结合位点具有更高的结合评分和更强的亲和力。这些发现表明，这些衍生物的诱导凋亡和细胞毒性活性可能为肿瘤治疗提供潜在的临床价值。
